# Introduction

The **`tableone`** analysis (Table One) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- This function generates a "Table One", a descriptive summary table frequently used in  clinicopathological research manuscripts. It supports multiple output styles for flexible formatting.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("tableone_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::tableone(
#   data = tableone_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `tableone` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
